findings.title: Failed stats request is shown as 'No harvests in this range' with no error or retry
findings.steps: Sign in, then open /stats?from=2026-12-01&to=2026-01-01 (API answers 422). Any other API failure (500, network down, timeout) takes the same path.
findings.expected: An error message (e.g. 'The From date must be on or before the To date.' or 'could not load stats') with a Retry button.
findings.actual: The page ignores `error` from useApiFetch. With stats null it shows the EmptyState 'No harvests in this range', so a failure looks like a successful empty result. There is no retry.
findings.evidence: curl of SSR /stats?from=2026-12-01&to=2026-01-01 with session cookie: the HTML contains 'No harvests in this range' and no alert; the API returns 422 {"detail":"The From date must be on or before the To date."}

findings.title: Invalid date that passes the client regex (e.g. 2026-02-30) shows as empty results
findings.steps: Open /stats?from=2026-02-30. queryDate accepts it because it matches \d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}, and the server rejects it with 422.
findings.expected: Fall back to the default or show a validation error.
findings.actual: 'No harvests in this range' is shown and the From input holds an invalid value.
findings.evidence: SSR HTML of /stats?from=2026-02-30 contains 'No harvests in this range'; API returns 422 'day value is outside expected range'.

findings.title: Stats request has no timeout, so the page can stay on 'Loading stats…' forever
findings.steps: Make the API hang (stall the connection) and open /stats or change a date.
findings.expected: The request fails after 10 s and shows an error with a retry.
findings.actual: No timeout is passed to useFetch/$fetch, so 'Loading stats…' can spin indefinitely. Even after a failure, nothing but the empty state is shown (see above).
findings.evidence: grep finds no 'timeout' anywhere in frontend/app; stats.vue calls useApiFetch('/stats/harvests', { query }) with no timeout.

findings.title: Clearing a date field silently uses the year default while the input stays blank
findings.expected: The input shows the date actually used, or the page says why it was rejected.
findings.actual: The query drops 'from' and the server defaults to 1 Jan of the current year. The input stays empty, while the summary line says 'from 1 Jan 2026'. If To is earlier than this year, the hidden default gives a 422, which then shows as 'No harvests'.
findings.evidence: stats.vue query computed omits empty values; stats.py defaults date_from to year_start.

findings.title: Months with no harvests are left out of the per-month table
findings.expected: Every month in the chosen range appears (at least between the first and last harvest), so the per-month view is continuous.
findings.actual: Only months that have harvests are returned: 2025-08 is followed directly by 2026-06, and the 9 months in between are missing, which hides the gap.
